name: Tara Chand Infra
why: Management outlook: As the new equipment is commissioned and deployed through Q3, we expect the margin gap to narrow.
Latest quarter Sep 2026: Good (sales +27% YoY, profit +21% YoY)
Promoters raised their stake by 1.0 pts in a year
Profits backed by cash: operating cash flow is 248% of 3-year profit
risks: Not at record: quarterly sales, annual profit
Margins shrinking (38% to 34%) - record profit may be near peak
Working capital stretching - debtor days 88 to 119, inventory days n/a (rising): check receivables / stock build-up
Credit rating BB/Stable (CRISIL) - weaker credit quality
Cost quality weak: margin shrinking or operating profit falling (costs 62% to 66% of sales)
Micro cap (Rs 368 Cr): thin trading, higher risk - keep the position small
Sector cycle: Weak / out of favour

order_book: As of October 2026, our order book stands at INR163.7 crores, executable entirely within FY27, with 74% from equipment hiring and projects and 26% from warehousing and transportation.
And in terms of your order book, so currently, it stands at about INR163 crores and for about 20% growth, H2 revenue approximately requires about INR190 crores.
guidance: As the new equipment is commissioned and deployed through Q3, we expect the margin gap to narrow.
Together with the revenue already booked in H1, this gives us the visibility to fulfill the full year guidance with confidence.
capex: As the new equipment is commissioned and deployed through Q3, we expect the margin gap to narrow.
The capex program has taken net debt to equity to the upper limit of 1 that we have set for ourselves, and we intend to operate within that ceiling.
risks: Before we proceed with this call, I would like to mention that some of the statements made in today's call may be forward -looking in nature and may involve risks and uncertainties.
While on margins, we expect that the full year EBITDA margin should be around 35%, below our earlier band of 37% to 35% on account of the first quarter challenges.
focus: And those -- a good amount of those coming into play in Q3 and Q4 will help with the growth trajectory that we are focusing on.
Considering that we are focusing on heavier equipment, and we will focus on those in the near future?
But we do -- as we have been saying that we are focusing and targeting a 20% to 25% annual growth.
